title: --no-verify push bypass for the pre-existing §6.AK self-reference gap between firebase-distribute.sh Gate 7 and pre-push Check 10
operator_authorization: explicit, in-conversation, scoped to this one push, via AskUserQuestion — 'How should I proceed?' -> '--no-verify this push only (recommended)'
root_cause: docs/scripts/check-cycle-coverage.sh.md §5 ('KNOWN CONSEQUENCE — pre-push Check 10 and the self-reference problem') already documents this as an open design question predating this session, with 3 named unimplemented resolutions and the explicit statement 'the choice belongs to the operator'. firebase-distribute.sh's own Gate 7 runs with --head = the commit carrying the code + evidence and therefore binds cleanly — it genuinely ran and PASSED for both real Firebase distributes this cycle (client 1.3.17-1087 debug, api-app 0.2.13-28 debug). .githooks/pre-push Check 10 re-runs the identical gate against the pointer-advancing commit, which by construction cannot embed its own git SHA, so the strict binding refuses there — not because coverage is missing, but because a commit cannot contain a hash of itself.
what_actually_happened: commit 54c50eaef3e39e9585817b92c9a739d39d836e03 (release-testing-infra) and commit c380abd944ab83a6c72635d4dde9bedeaed5b751 (distribute evidence, advances last-version-debug) both carry real, genuinely-executed device-gate evidence (§6.Z) that Gate 7 verified against the correct HEAD at the moment each real distribute ran. No coverage claim in either commit is fabricated or unverified — the mismatch is purely a commit-SHA self-reference artifact of git's content-addressing, exactly as the pre-existing doc predicts.
not_bypassed: scripts/firebase-distribute.sh's own Phase 1 Gate 7 (the actual gate that authorized the two real Firebase uploads) was never bypassed and ran to a genuine PASS both times, independently of this incident.
bypassed: the .githooks/pre-push hook's own re-invocation of scripts/check-cycle-coverage.sh (Check 10) via `git push --no-verify`, scoped to this one push only.
next_steps_owed: one of the 3 named resolutions in docs/scripts/check-cycle-coverage.sh.md §5 (gate the code commit instead of the pointer-advance commit; accept an ancestor SHA when only .lava-ci-evidence//docs//CHANGELOG.md differ; or formally adopt 'author evidence at distribute time only' as the standing policy) remains an open design decision for a future session — not resolved by this bypass.
